column1: # method: bin/qmx check src --format=metrics --workers=0 was run over the whole
# src/ tree (product's own analysis reader) and every "metrics" object key
# in the resulting symbols was collected (294 distinct spellings). Each
# spelling was stripped of a trailing aggregation suffix when the suffix is
# a real AggregationStrategy::cases() value (sum, avg, max, min, count, p95,
# p5, read via `AggregationStrategy::cases()`, not hand-copied), giving 82
# distinct published base keys. Six of those are health.* (a different
# namespace, already owned by ComputedMetricFormulaValidator's fourth check,
# validateComputedMetricReferences()) and are excluded from this table's
# comparison; 76 remain. `constant` is whether the base key has a
# `public const string` in MetricName.php, read via
# uses at runtime) -- not a text grep of the file, so this measurement cannot
# share a blind spot with scripts/finding-gate/MetricVocabulary.php's regex
# what this does not see: a metric key a collector only emits under a
# condition this particular src/ run never triggered (four code-smell keys --
# property,constant} -- and two security keys -- security.hardcoded-
# credentials, security.sensitive-parameter -- are constants with no row
# below because this run raised none of those findings; they are not a gap,
# they are absent from "published" only for this input). It also cannot see
# a key no collector emits on any input at all (a dead constant), nor a key a
# collector emits only outside src/ (e.g. only in benchmarks/ or a fixture
# result: gap (published non-health base key with no MetricName constant) is
# empty -- every one of the 76 non-health published base keys measured here
# has a constant. Per the plan (03-blind-spots.md, package C1), an empty gap
# means the fifth validator check's catalog is built from MetricName's
# constants, not from a wider republished-universe list.
